Synthetic regression scenario authored from the kind of artifacts described in published Pegasus forensic reports. This is not a recovered device artifact, actual MVT detection, known-compromised device image, or independent validation. Names, paths, dates, and indicator labels are fictional. Use only to verify that a report containing one mocked indicator match remains cautious. Pegasus Hunter's text and JSON reports mark this as `synthetic_test_fixture`; it is not a real-device assessment.
